title: San Miguel Watershed Forum
description:
Join us for the 2026 San Miguel Watershed Forum on October 20 at 9:00 AM at the Telluride Science and Innovation Center.
This year’s theme is Increasing Capacity for Water Projects. The morning includes a watershed update, a Coalition Board panel, and a funding workshop with speakers from the Colorado Agricultural Water Alliance, Southwestern Water Conservation District, Colorado Water Conservation Board, and Colorado Water Quality Control Division. Lunch is followed by an afternoon stakeholder committee meeting.
Come for as much of the day as you can. The Forum is free and lunch is a taco bar! Please RSVP Here
